title: Safin-1.5: Safety-Native Architecture and Verifiable Reasoning for Recursive Safety Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2610.40751v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) enables large language models to advance their capabilities through successive updates, but these updates can also introduce new risks and weaken existing safeguards. In line with the AI-45{\deg} Law, we pursue Safety RSI, in which safety develops as an intrinsic capability alongside general model capabilities through continual risk discovery and repair, while preserving utility and limiting over-refusal. We introduce Safin-1.5, a model built on a safety architecture and trained through recursive safety improvement, with an inference-time harness that extends its capabilities to formal reasoning. Our approach comprises three components: i) The safety architecture combines persistent safety states with hazardous-knowledge disentanglement. translated_title: Safin-1.5：面向递归安全改进的安全原生架构与可验证推理
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）使大型语言模型能够通过 successive 更新不断提升自身能力，但这些更新也可能引入新的风险并削弱现有的安全保障。为遵循AI-45度法则，我们追求安全RSI（Safety RSI），即通过持续的风险发现与修复，使安全能力作为内在能力与模型的通用能力一同发展，同时保持实用性并限制过度拒答。我们提出了Safin-1.5，一个建立在安全架构之上、通过递归安全改进训练而成的模型，并配有推理时框架将其能力扩展至形式化推理。我们的方法包含三个组成部分：i) 安全架构将持久化安全状态与危险知识解耦相结合。前者保留并有选择地调用安全知识，后者则将特定的危险知识迁移至可移除的专家模块中，从而实现对这些知识的移除（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出Safin-1.5模型，通过将持久化安全状态与危险知识解耦相结合的安全原生架构，以及递归安全改进训练和推理时形式化推理框架，使大语言模型在自我能力提升的同时持续发现并修复安全风险。
en_tdlr: Safin-1.5 introduces a safety-native architecture combining persistent safety states with hazardous-knowledge disentanglement, trained through recursive safety improvement with an inference-time harness for verifiable formal reasoning, enabling LLMs to strengthen safety alongside capability gains.
